g.text: Staff is logged in; staffId is their own identity.
Planning window: five weeks of 12-hour day/night shifts.
isLate = submittedAt > Wednesday cutoff for that week.
Cutoff time is a policy input; lateWeeks records affected weeks.
Saved availability and late flags are visible to managers.
UML 2.5. UI/Control classes and operations are proposed design.
SQL is illustrative PostgreSQL; mappings and notification assumptions are in interaction-contract.md.
I01: late availability is explicitly saved to satisfy source postconditions.
Main success and all documented alternatives
